column1: # The engine finds Minoc's entrance sealed: from the entry cell (15,30) only
# (14,29), (15,29), (16,29) and (15,31) are reachable, at every hour of the
# day, and all eleven of the town's NPCs are unreachable on foot. The blockers
# are vehicle, furniture and npc-sprite objects rather than walls.
# An earlier revision of this scenario probed north and west only, found the
# stock game blocked in the same places, and concluded the enclosure was shipped
# geometry. That was two directions out of four. This walks all of them.
# requires-seed: the party on Minoc's entry cell (15,30)
